body.headline: Good start: both sessions done, easy pace held. Week 1 unchanged.
body.summary:
A short first week, and you did **exactly** what was planned.

Your easy run came in at the slow end of the *E* range, which is right for a re-entry block. Sleep averaged 7.1 h.

## Next week
- Keep both runs conversational
- Add the core session on Tuesday
- If the calves feel tight, swap Friday’s spin for a walk
observations: Saturday 5 km at 6:21/km, inside the easy range.
